name: dashboard-bridge
description: Dashboard integration and orchestrator bridge for dev-suite. Provides dashboard access, config management, and task orchestration with WebSocket communication for real-time updates.

envVars.name: DASHBOARD_PORT
envVars.description: Port for the dashboard HTTP server

envVars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_WS_PORT
envVars.description: Port for the orchestrator WebSocket server

envVars.name: DASHBOARD_HOST
envVars.description: Host the dashboard server listens on. Defaults to 127.0.0.1; only change it if the dashboard was started with HOST set.

envVars.name: DEV_SUITE_DIR
envVars.description: Absolute path of the dev-suite checkout. Set automatically by the launcher; override only for a non-standard layout.

envVars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_WS_TOKEN
envVars.description: Shared secret a client must present to drive the orchestrator WebSocket. Generated per process and printed to stderr when unset.

envVars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_WS_HOST
envVars.description: Host the orchestrator WebSocket binds to. Defaults to 127.0.0.1; this socket accepts job submissions, so do not expose it.
